title: ChatAgentDigest
description: chat.agent-digest@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S5): what a chat room said to an agent between two of its steps, GET /api/v1/rooms/agent:<id>/digest?since= on OpenVibe.Chat. The agent never reads the raw room: it asks for a digest and gets at most ten items and 1,500 characters. Each item names who (the display name and the handle), what (cut to 200 characters), its kind (a question, a suggestion or a reaction) and its upvotes (a thumbs up on the message counts). Chat chooses what goes in: repeats are grouped, greetings and spam are dropped, and the most-upvoted questions and suggestions come first. Nobody is left out by accident: a person who is timed out or banned, whose account is younger than a day, or who set 'Agents don't read my messages' is never in the digest. A link is kept as its domain only ('a link to github.com'), because the agent never follows a link from chat. The code and the commands stay as text: the agent's own tools and approvals decide what may run, never chat.

room.description: The room the digest came from: an agent stream's room, `agent:<ags_id>`.

since.description: The start of the window: the moment the agent last read, or null for the first read.

until.description: The end of the window: the moment this digest was made.

items.description: What chat said, at most ten items. The order is the one Chat chose: the most-upvoted questions and suggestions first, the reactions last.

who.description: Who said it: the display name and the handle. Never an id, never an email, never anything else about them.

handle.description: The handle, so the agent can answer this person by name.

what.description: What they said, cut to 200 characters. A link is kept as its domain only.

kind.description: What the line is: a question the agent may answer, a suggestion it may take or leave, or a reaction (a thumbs up, a cheer) that says nothing to do.

upvotes.description: How many thumbs up the message carries. The most-upvoted items come first.

repeated.description: How many people said this same thing. Chat groups repeats into one item; this is the number behind it.

chars.description: How many characters the items use together, at most 1,500.

truncated.description: True when Chat left something out because of the ten-item or 1,500-character cap.
